title: Industrial Activity Grew in April After 7% Expansion of the Construction Sector: Sheinbaum
author: Alonso Urrutia and Alma E. Muñoz
content:
_This article by Alonso Urrutia and Alma E. Muñoz originally appeared in
the[June 12, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/06/12/economia/crecimiento-
de-21-de-la-actividad-industrial-en-abril-resultado-de-la-expansion-del-
sector-de-la-construccion-sheinbaum), Mexico's premier left-wing daily
newspaper._

Mexico City. During the month of April, industrial activity grew 2.1 percent,
in large measure because the construction industry rose close to 7 percent,
President Claudia Sheinbaum stated, considering that this represents "good
numbers" for the country. Likewise, she highlighted the new record in Mexican
exports in April with 709 billion dollars, above the 692 billion dollars
reached last March.

Meanwhile, the Tourism Secretary, Josefina Rodríguez, said that in April three
new records were registered in the performance of this sector: 8.3 million
international visitors were reached, an 8 percent growth in April compared to
the same period of 2025; 3.81 million international tourists were reported,
1.8 percent compared to April of last year; and 1.25 million cruise passengers
were registered, 31.5 percent more than 2025.

In the cumulative four-month period, the secretariat reported that there have
been 34.5 million international visitors, 9.7 percent more than in the same
period of 2025; 16.5 million foreign tourists were reported, 5.5 percent more
than the first four-month period of 2025 with an economic impact of 13.255
billion dollars; and there were 4.88 million cruise passengers, 13 percent
more than in the same period last year.
